coverage.scope: bounded trial: 3 sampled product pages out of the product URLs in sitemap.xml
coverage.notes: The denominator is the number of product URLs matched by ^/\d+-\d+\.htm$ in sitemap.xml at discovery time. Covered counts sampled candidates with a processed verdict in this bounded task, not the whole catalogue; the sitemap can change between runs and is not independently audited.

business_acceptance.reason: Bounded framework-comparison trial; user acceptance pending.

runtime.browser_cleanup: PlaywrightCrawler.run() returned; the crawler closed its browser pool.

notes: Bounded trial: 30 product pages or 10 minutes, whichever comes first.
robots.txt publishes Crawl-delay: 10; top-level requests are spaced by 10 s with concurrency 1.
robots.txt disallows */catalog and */wishlist; no such URL is enqueued.
Prices are the lowest positive variant offer in the page's own JSON-LD, including out-of-stock variants; strikethrough prices are not read.
Coverage covered counts processed candidates in this bounded task, not the whole catalogue.
No model or other LLM is called at runtime.
This candidate does not implement pause/resume; every run purges its Crawlee queue and is a new task.
